lastCompletedStory.title: Extract shared ratchet-diff helpers for the check scripts

nextStoryContext: US-001 shrank scripts/check-coverage.ts to 234 lines (ceiling 261) and scripts/check-file-sizes.ts to 181 lines (ceiling 209); both ceilings were left unchanged (never raise). scripts/ratchet-diff.ts (57 lines) is new and intentionally NOT added to scripts/file-size-budget.json (consistent with existing convention: not every scripts/*.ts has a budget entry, e.g. scripts/check-version-skips.ts). jscpd on src+scripts after this story: still passing at the current threshold (6); US-003 (lower threshold to 4) should re-measure after US-002 lands, per its own notes, since US-002 is the other dedup story. US-002 (extract parseSubcommandArgs in index.ts) is independent of this story's files (index.ts untouched here) and can proceed without any dependency on this change.
